default.description: Directory where abook stores its data files

data_dir.description: Directory where abook stores its data files (e.g., abook.db, aliases)

default.description: Path to the main abook database file

db_file.description: Path to the main abook database file

default.description: Path to the address book alias file

alias_file.description: Path to the address book alias file (used by Mutt via external command)

format.description: Format used when exporting aliases (mutt is the standard for Mutt compatibility)

pager.description: Enable/disable pager for long output (0 = off, 1 = on)

fields.description: List of fields to display in interactive mode (e.g., name, email, nick)

select_command.description: Optional: custom command to run when selecting an address (e.g., to insert into Mutt)

edit_command.description: Optional: command to run when editing an entry (e.g., editor)

outformatstr.description: Optional: custom output format string for --mutt-query or --convert with format=custom (e.g., "{nick}: {email}")
